{{Quote|Agent Carhart, SIS. The Supreme Chancellor asked me to make sure you were aware of the situation. She's hoping you'll volunteer to help.|Carhart|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Carhart''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Corellia]], Carhart was tasked by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] with recruiting individuals to aid the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Battle for the Black Hole|fight]] for the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] region.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Carhart provides Republic players with the mission "Corellia Rising," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole.<ref name="TOR" />
